## Stereoscopic 3D: atmosphere and focus zone

### Features
- **Depth effects**: Fade (darken), Haze (fog) and Blur (ghost smudge) per layer, strongest on the layer farthest from the focus zone.
- **Configurable focus zone** (Focus Back/Front): layers inside are untouched by every effect; outside, effects grow linearly with the distance to the zone edge. Blur applies in both directions (depth of field).
- Menu reorganized: Depth / Focus / Effects with inline explanations; game-settings section renamed to 3D STEREOSCOPIC SETTINGS; the physical 3D slider is the only 3D control (0 = exact 2D).
- Depth gauge values gray out when the layer leaves the focus zone.

### Fixes
- Ghost blur no longer blacks out layers in color-math scenes (dialog boxes): ghost passes preserve the destination alpha used as the color-math mask.
- Menu spacing cleanup (doubled blank lines removed across tabs).
